05/20.04.2023: Heard the parties.

The applicant-husband, who is in custody since 07.10.2022, has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Gumla S.C./S.T. P.S. Case No.08 of 2022 (POCSO Case No.73 of 2022) registered for the offence under Sections 417, 376(3), 420, 509, 354, 313 read with Section 34 IPC, Section 4 of the POCSO Act and Section 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s), 3(1)(P), 3 (1)(w)(i) and 3(1)(w)(ii) of the S.C./S.T. Act.

entities.text: Gumla S.C./S.T. P.S. Case No.08 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: It has been submitted by the counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
Innocence has been claimed and participation in the trial has been assured.
It has been submitted that both the parties were in love and accordingly, they have got married in the year 2020.
Thereafter, some dispute has arisen and this case has been lodged.
S.C. & S.T. Act is not made out as they are husband and wife and other allegation is nothing but exaggeration.
On the above facts, prayer for bail has been made.
On the other hand, learned A.P.P. and counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for bail and it has been submitted that she has been cheated.
Considering the above facts, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant (s) on bail.

Accordingly, the applicant(s), above named, is/are directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Suraj Kumar Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9565777/
1 Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Addl. Sessions Judge-IV-cum-Special Judge, POCSO, Gumla, in connection with Gumla S.C./S.T. P.S. Case No.08 of 2022 (POCSO Case No.73 of 2022) on the condition that the applicant(s) will submit self-attested photocopy of his/her/their Aadhaar Card(s) and also submit his/her/their mobile number(s) before the learned court below which he/she/they will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
